name: walk a key-scrambled permutation, swapping two entries per output byte
mechanism: initialise a permutation of all byte values and scramble it by swaps driven by the key; then, per output byte, advance one index, move a second index by the value found there, swap the two entries, and output the entry at the position given by their sum

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'RC4 (cipher)' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

fails_when: the first output bytes are biased; related-key weaknesses
